scorecard.venue: Maharaja Yadavindra Singh International Cricket Stadium, Mullanpur

batting.name: Priyansh Arya
batting.dismissal: c V Shankar b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c DP Conway b KK Ahmed

batting.name: N Wadhera
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b R Ashwin

batting.name: R Ravindra
batting.dismissal: st P Simran Singh b GJ Maxwell

batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c Shashank Singh b LH Ferguson

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b Yash Thakur

balls.text: full outside off. Shashank gets his hands through the ball and drills it past extra cover. Noor comes around from long off, puts in the slide and seems to save a single. Shashank, either way, gets to his fifty, and PBKS finish with 219!

back of a length wide outside off. Jansen initially shapes for the scoop but has to then change his stroke because of how wide it was. Gets an inside edge and Dhoni gets his left paw to it to keep it to a single
clean as a whistle! Slower ball on a fullish length on off stump. Drops on Jansen late but he continues with his swing. Full extension of those long levers and he slams this over the bowler's head!
low full toss on middle and leg. Shashank has a swish at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball rolls away into the off side for a single
length ball fired across the batter outside off. Shashank shuffles across, looking for the scoop but only ends up nutmegging himself
attempted leg-stump yorker that slides down leg. Shashank does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Shashank tries to smash that into the mountains and only grabs a handful of fresh air
low full toss on leg stump. Shashank moves across his stumps and tucks it off his toes towards deep backward square leg
right in the gap, and Shashank is not relenting! Slot ball on leg stump. Shashank gets his front foot out of the way and whips it between long on and deep mid wicket!
into the blockhole on leg stump. Jansen jams down on it and digs it out towards long on
fullish on leg stump. Jansen plants his front foot, uses his wrists and flicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
streaky, but they all count! Slower bumper just outside off. Jansen has a massive swipe across the line and the ball skews off the leading edge, beating short third to his left!

back of a length delivery that pitches a mile outside leg. Skips off and raps Jansen on the pads, perhaps on leg stump. Khaleel appeals as the ball rolls towards backward point. Choudhary fires a needless throw at the bowler's end and they concede another
banged into the track outside off, as a response to Jansen advancing. He gets under it but does not get any sort of power into the stroke. Spoons it over backward point for a single

did Shashank hit it? If not, he might be in trouble here! Full toss on middle and leg. Tails in a little and Shashank seems to get an inside edge before the ball strikes him on the pad. CSK go upstairs because, well, why not. Clear inside edge and our original suspicion has been confirmed. Decision stays, and CSK lose a review!
right into the blockhole on middle and off. Jansen gets his bat down in time and the ball skews off the toe-end behind square on the leg side
full just outside off. Shashank plants his front foot and drills it down the ground towards long off
searing in-swinging yorker on leg stump. Jansen jams down on it and squeezes it out towards long on

taxi, where are you?! Right in the slot on middle and leg, and Jansen, once he has made connection, does not even look to see where that has flown. Free extension of the arms and that went soaring over long on!
back of a length on leg stump. Jansen walks well across his stumps and swipes it towards deep backward square leg. Khaleel does nice work on the fence and keeps it to a single
back of a length just outside off. Shashank opens up his stance and hacks it on the bounce to long on

oh my - this is going to bring down rain! And dropped by CSK - dear, oh dear! Googly on a length on the stumps. Shashank has a huge swipe across the line and skies it. Ravindra runs in from deep mid wicket, settles under it and then shells it. CSK cannot catch a break. Or a chance...
dispatched! That is a woeful delivery. A half-tracker outside off that had Noor's toe-nails in danger for a while. Shashank stands tall and thumps it over wide long off!
angled across on a length just outside off. Jansen has a slog across the line and toe-ends it towards extra cover
fired in full on off. Shashank gets down on one knee and hoicks it towards deep backward square leg
off-pace on a full length outside off. Shashank tips it to extra cover and saunters across to the other end
zipped in full on middle and off. Jansen cannot get under it and squeezes it out to long on
length outside off. Jansen extends his arms and powers it towards long off. Noor nearly over-runs it to his left but does enough to recover and prevent the boundary
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Jansen swings for the hills and toe-ends it towards Dhoni, who dives to his right and ensures it is a dot
full just outside off. Shashank shuffles across and pushes it down the ground to long on
full on middle and leg. Jansen plants his front foot and cloths it down the ground to long on
fired in on a length on middle and off. Holds a little in the surface and Jansen plonks it towards long off
back of a length outside off. Forces Shashank to play off the back foot into the off side and he chops it towards sweeper cover
short, wide again and punished this time! Sits up nicely this time and Shashank waits on it long enough to crack it past backward point!
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Left alone and that sneaks just inside the tramlines
back of a length outside off. Shashank taps it towards extra cover off the back foot
back of a length on middle and leg. Shashank has a swipe across the line and misses, getting hit on the boundary
fired in very full just outside leg. Jansen looks for the reverse and the ball seems to just sneak past leg stump. On another day, that would have been curtains for Jansen
oh, hello! Given a bit of air just outside off. Jansen shimmies down the track and times it exquisitely, beating long on to his left!

taken on the fence, and the Priyansh Arya show is over! But what a show it was! Breathtaking at every moment, and just as belligerent to knock the stuffing out of CSK! Tossed up full just outside off. Seems like the googly and this cramps Arya a little as he tries to slog it over long on. Off the inside half of the bat and Shankar snares the chance at long on. A standing ovation as Arya walks off, and pretty sure there will be countless people at home standing in front of their TV sets and phone/laptop screens doing the same!
back of a length on leg stump. Shashank hangs back and pushes it towards deep mid wicket
floated up full and wide. Arya plants his front foot and smashes it on the bounce to deep cover
leg-spinner on a full length, following the batter outside leg. Shashank misses it with his bat and the ball rolls off his pad for a leg bye
slower ball on a length outside off. Stops on Arya a little and he nearly pops it straight to extra cover. On the bounce, and PBKS fans breathe a sigh of relief

edged and four! A hundred for Priyansh Arya inside 13 overs of an IPL innings - and this has been a knock right out of the top drawer! Sizzling, stunning and absolutely sensational! Zipped in full on middle and off. Arya gets a little squared up as he looks to flick but the ball takes enough of the outside edge to fly past short third. Takes his helmet off, soaks in the applause. The innings of his dreams, and it has come against the five-time champions!

three sixes in the over, and this youngster is enjoying his time out in the Mullanpur floodlights! A bit of a half-tracker. Not enough pace to hustle the batter, not enough bounce to make him miscue it. Arya stands up tall and swipes it over deep square leg!
goes all the way again! Arya is tearing Pathirana apart! Dug into the track just outside off. Arya rises with the bounce and swats it just over the wide long on fence!
oh my word - that is a world-class shot! Low full toss hung up wide outside off. Arya peels the outer cover off the ball and scythes it over deep point!
back of a length outside off. Shashank gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side for an easy single
back of a length outside off. Shashank punches it down the ground towards long on
Shashank wants a piece of Ashwin too! This is getting very predictable now. Slot ball outside off and Shashank picks the carrom ball to pump this over Ashwin's head!
carrom ball on a fullish length on middle and leg. Shashank plays all around it and gets rapped on the pads
back of a length outside off. Arya reaches out for it and flat-bats it towards long off

caught by Choudhary, but he has stepped onto the ropes! Drama in Mullanpur! Carrom ball slanted across the batter full outside off. Arya slices across it completely but still gets it far enough towards long off. Choudhary hold onto the chance but also steps onto the rope while doing so. Not the greatest effort in the world, and Ashwin, who thought he had a wicket, has six against his name again!
bam! Arya goes big again! Dragged down on middle and leg, and this just sits up for Arya. He lines it up and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
on a length on middle and off. Arya gets down on one knee and sweeps it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
googly on a length on middle and off. Spins back a touch, goes past the inside edge and raps Arya on the pad. Would have been going down with the angle, though
angled in on a length on leg stump. Arya bunts it to the edge of the ring in the mid wicket region and races back for two. Excellent running!
that is a dreadful delivery, and it gets punished! Half-tracker a mile outside leg. Arya, after rubbing his eyes in disbelief, helps it over short fine leg!
fuller on leg stump. Shashank lunges forward and nudges it towards deep backward square leg
right - that is one way to greet the leading wicket-taker of the comp! Googly that lands right in the slot outside off. Shashank gets down on one knee and clobbers it over wide long on!
fired in full again, on middle and leg. Shashank pats it to long on and retains strike
carrom ball on a length just outside off. Shashank presses forward and plays it back to the bowler
carrom ball on a length just outside off. Shashank backs away and slices it towards deep point. He has to hustle back for two and might have been in trouble with a better throw
length just outside off. Shashank reads the carrom ball off the pitch and defends
another carrom-ball, on a length on middle and leg. Arya squirts it off the inside edge towards deep mid wicket
carrom ball on a full length on off. Shashank gets fully forward and eases it to long on
back of a length outside off. Shashank taps it towards backward point and retains strike
slanted in on a length on off. Shashank gets across his stumps and paddles it fine for a couple of runs
back of a length just outside off. Arya goes back and punches it towards long on
length outside off. Shashank gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long off for a single
back of a length on leg stump. Shashank hangs back and pokes it towards the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Arya hangs back and jabs it towards deep point

Ashwin pulls off a stunner off his own bowling, and now he is properly overjoyed! Carrom ball, slowed up on a length on the stumps. Maxwell backs away, trying to blast that through Ashwin. Picks Ashwin out to perfection and the bowler, after a bit of a bobble, holds on. Ashwin will not mind one bit. CSK will not mind one bit. And Maxwell cannot believe what has just happened. Half of the PBKS side now back in the shed!
back of a length on the stumps. Arya glances it towards short fine leg
angled across again, on a length just outside off. Arya has a tentative prod at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his front pad
darted in full on leg stump. Maxwell gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards long on

goes straight up, and Dhoni was not going to drop that! Not in a million years! Fired across the batter on a length outside off. Wadhera swings his blade like an axe and while he might have scythed through a tree, he cannot get purchase on this. Only gets height, that too off the outside half of the bat, and Dhoni calls early to do the rest. Ashwin is pleased, and Wadhera has to walk back!
back of a length outside off. Wadhera hangs back and jabs it towards extra cover

back of a length on middle and off. Skids off the surface and Arya, shaping to reverse, gets into a mess. Dhoni appealed for the lbw but no one else really did. Might have scraped the glove, and the impact may have been outside the line as well
full outside off. Arya presses forward and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Arya gets down on one knee (almost) and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
on a length outside off. Wadhera skips down the track and works it towards deep mid wicket. The call is for two initially but Conway is sharp off his mark and denies that pursuit
back of a length outside off. Arya opens up his stance and hoicks it on the bounce to long on. Jadeja got away with that one there
full and angled across well outside off. Wadhera fetches it and drags his sweep behind square for a single. And Jadeja has overstepped as well. CSK's problems get compounded...
back of a length just outside off. Wadhera takes a step across his stumps before plonking it back towards the bowler

a 19-ball fifty for Priyansh Arya, against the five-time champions! Take a bow, lad! Marginally short just outside off. Arya spots the length early, gives himself room and carves it off the back foot over the wide long off fence. A classy shot to bookend what has been a classy half-century!
darted in full but also down leg. Dhoni moves to his right and gets something behind it. Called a wide, though
length outside off. Wadhera gets forward and eases it to long off
wow - what a way to announce your arrival!  Fired in again, fullish on middle and leg. Wadhera dances down the track and whips it over deep mid wicket!
fired in very full, just outside leg. A riposte to the batter advance, but Arya jams it into the pitch and the ball bounces up over Ashwin to allow a single
follows the batter well outside leg with a shortish ball. Arya holds his stance and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
Arya welcomes Ashwin with a boundary! Angled in on a length on middle and off. Arya gets down on one knee and slugs it over square leg!

in the air again, and this time, CSK do hold on! Khaleel glides like an airplane while staring down Stoinis, and CSK have three in the powerplay! Back of a length in the channel and this one nips away with the angle. Stoinis was probably playing for the ball coming in, and closed his bat face too early, trying to work to leg. Tame leading edge and Conway makes no mistake at backward point. Stoinis throws his head back in disappointment; Khaleel anything but a picture of disappointment!
slower bumper outside off. Balloons through and Arya, after waiting and waiting for it, helps it towards deep mid wicket

palmed past the post! That might also technically go down as a chance! Length ball hung up wide outside off. Arya drives on the up and drives uppishly. Shankar flings himself to his left, gets his left mitt to it but cannot cling on. Even tougher than the earlier chance!
back of a length outside off. Stoinis hangs back and chops it into the off side

dropped again - CSK not helping themselves in the field! Half-tracker outside off. Stoinis gets up on his toes and smashes it towards mid wicket. Shankar leaps up, gets both hands to it but the ball bursts through. Tough chance because of how hard it was hit, but CSK probably need to hang on to one of these, just to get their confidence and belief going!
fullish on leg stump. Stoinis presses forward and pushes it down the ground to mid on
back of a length outside off. Stoinis waits on it and plays it late, cutting it towards deep backward point to get off the mark
on a length outside off. Arya tries to force it through the off side and perhaps tries to hit it too hard. Shanked into the mid wicket region
Arya is on absolute fire here! Right in the slot just outside off. Arya gets forward, shows the maker's name and bangs it over mid off. Holds the pose too!
four more! A bit of a nothing short ball outside off, getting up near the waist. Arya sizes it up early and then muscles it past mid wicket!

Arya is not holding back! He wants to counter-punch! Full and swinging away outside off. Arya plants his front foot, goes through the line and cracks it between extra cover and cover point. It was in the air but well away from both fielders!
back of a length just outside off. Arya hangs back and taps it into the off side with soft hands
back of a length just outside off. Stoinis gets up on his toes and punches it towards mid off
back of a length on middle and off. Nips away a touch and Stoinis is happy to let it go

off stump goes cartwheeling, and Khaleel has produced an absolute corker to take down the PBKS captain! Khaleel is absolutely pumped, and why wouldn't he be. This starts on a fullish length just outside off and then swerves back in sharply. Shreyas looks to drive down the ground and is all at sea as the ball whistles past his inside edge. Off stump left in an absolute mess, and CSK have two wickets in two overs now!
fullish outside off, shaping away. Shreyas stays on the shot long enough and stays on top of the bounce to drive it towards deep backward point
that is a glorious maximum! Slot ball on the pads and Shreyas climbs into it. Maintains his balance, opens up his stance a touch and clips it delightfully over mid on!
short ball on leg stump that bounces a touch extra and cramps Shreyas for room. He hops around his crease and fends it into the on side
Arya is going after Choudhary too! And this is massive! Dug into the track on leg stump. Sits up nicely for Arya and he gets inside the line to hook it onto the second deck over fine leg!
hard length on middle and off. Gets a little big on Shreyas and he hacks it towards mid on to get off the mark
back of a length on middle and off. Shreyas presses half forward and defends. That might have just moved away a little after pitching
yes, they do! Banged into the track but well outside off. Shreyas looks to cut and chops it into the off side

chopped on, and Choudhary has instant redemption! Back of a length just outside off and this curves back in late. Prabhsimran, going walkabouts down the track, looks to dab it away but the lack of room does for him. Gets a thick inside edge and finds his leg stump flattened soon after. Choudhary has a wicket, and CSK have some respite after being carted all over the park in the opening over!
back of a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran gets up on his toes and taps it tamely towards mid wicket
back of a length, swinging into off stump. Arya has a poke at it and chunks it off the inside edge through square leg for a couple of runs
that is another stunning shot! Back of a length and too much width on offer. Arya frees his arms with no care in the world and thumps it flat over cover point!
just wide of the fielder! Back of a length outside off and this climbs onto Arya. He fends at it and the ball floats off the outside edge, beating Choudhary to his left at short third
into the blockhole wide outside off. Arya jams down on it and slices it towards backward point. Jadeja flies to his left and grabs it one-handed. But it was a Free hit. Top fielding effort, though
hard length, slanting into middle and leg. Cramped for room, Arya tugs it towards mid wicket. Uh-oh, Khaleel has overstepped too. Not the start CSK needed...

dropped - oh dear! It is all happening here! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Shapes away late and that squares up Arya. He stabs at it and the ball spoons up off the leading edge. Khaleel flings out his right hand but cannot make it stick. Might have come at him slower than he expected
up, up and away first ball! That is some early statement! Back of a length wide outside off. Arya throws his hands at it and flays it over point!

The Punjab Kings win at home, and no, this is not a drill! They have trumped the Chennai Super Kings in a high-scoring contest, and cue the fireworks! They go off, and there are smiles all over in the PBKS camp! And the Super Kings, so often the pace-setters, so often the team to beat, will leave Mullanpur languishing near the bottom of the table, and with an unenviable 1-4 record against their name! This is a slower ball just outside off. Shankar heaves at it and drills it down the ground to long on. Not nearly enough from the Super Kings' perspective, and their wait to chase a score in excess of 180 continues, even as those in red around them embrace and celebrate their third win in just four games!
full and wider outside off. Jadeja reaches out for it and slices it towards deep backward point for a single
full and wide outside off. Jadeja looks to sweep it away but only grabs a handful of fresh air. Full enough to sneak under the bat. Wide enough to take it outside Jadeja's arc

over the fence. Just! But it will all be a consolation effort now! Slow and short outside off. Jadeja picks the slower one early and thumps it flat over long on. Lands on the full on the rope, and that will be six!
slower ball on a full length on middle and off. Shankar winds up and drags it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single, though

Dhoni bites the dust, and Thakur holds his arms aloft! Shreyas cannot believe it, Dhoni cannot believe it, and countless CSK fans cannot believe it either! The great man walks off for a 12-ball 27, and that could be that for CSK tonight! Low full toss a mile outside leg. On most days, Dhoni would have plundered that for six. Tonight, he hits it straight to Chahal at short fine leg, who after a bobble, holds on. CSK hearts sink, and PBKS hearts jump up and roar in delight!
gets it much fuller and wider this time, meaning Dhoni cannot get under it. He jams down on it and squeezes it out on the bounce to deep backward point

oh, hello! Oh, hello! This is 2006 all over again, is it?! Misses the wide yorker on the shorter side outside off. Dhoni plants his front foot and crrrrrrrrunnnnnnnnnnchhhhhheesssss it over extra cover!
goes for the surprise short ball, but Dhoni is up to the task! May have picked it a little late but did so in time. Swivels and helps it away behind square for four!
full toss outside off. Jadeja swings like a rusty gate and gets no timing on it at all. A tame miscue down the ground to long on and a single is all he will get

dropped at point! Oh my! Yash Thakur the fielder again! Full and wide outside off. Dhoni does well to reach it and scoops it towards point off the toe-end. Thakur grasses another sitter, and Dhoni gets a life!
full and wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines, Dhoni lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide. No review by PBKS this time
full toss outside off and Jadeja misses out. Swings hard at it but shanks it towards long on

Dhoni goes back to back, and he does it with a six over the keeper's head! Borderline waist-high full toss on off stump. Dhoni throws the plumbing at it and gets it off the top edge, and the ball flies over the keeper! Called a No ball too, and PBKS have taken it upstairs! Ball Tracking coming up. Waist is measured at 1.01m and the ball was at 0.98m. Decision overturned! A fair delivery, and that will be the end of the over!

Bang! Dhoni goes big, and he finally gets one out of the middle! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Dhoni picks the slower one early, swings at it with all his might and smokes it over long off!
very full and hung up wide outside off. Conway can only lay bat on it and the ball chops away into the on side. CSK have hit a submerged log in these last few overs

massive lbw shout, not given! Slanted in full on leg stump. Dhoni has an almighty slog at it and misses, with the ball trickling off the back leg behind point. Dhoni was ambling along and might have been out with a direct hit at the bowler's end. And to add further drama, Ferguson and Prabhsimran have convinced their captain to review. This could be close. No bat involved but Ball Tracking has the ball clipping leg stump. Umpire's Call, and Dhoni survives!

brilliant, brilliant work on the fence! Slower ball on a length on off, bowled from around the wicket. Conway hauls it towards long on, where Shreyas does excellent work running around to his left to pull the ball back into play. There is a check ongoing to see if Shreyas did that cleanly, and the verdict is that he did. Just a single
zipped into the blockhole on the pads. Dhoni misses his swing and the ball trickles away into the square leg region off the pad. Just a leg bye

fuller and much wider outside off. Conway goes inside-out but no timing on it at all. Clinks it over extra cover and he gets two for his toil. Just nine off the over, and that is a great over from a PBKS POV
back of a length outside off. Conway reaches out for it and chips it over extra cover. Just another brace, though. CSK need boundaries
back of a length on middle and leg. Dhoni goes back and punches it towards deep mid wicket
full on middle and leg. Conway clears his front leg and drills it on the bounce to long on. He is utterly disappointed with that attempt
just over! Short and wide outside off. Conway throws the kitchen sink at it and slices it just over backward point. Back for a brace
back of a length on middle and leg. Dhoni hangs back and tugs at it, squirting it off the inside edge behind square

oh dear - terrible mix-up, but PBKS cannot make CSK pay! Angled in on a length on the pads. Dhoni tucks it towards mid wicket and then has a mid-pitch chat with Conway, who is ball-watching. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end and misses to let Conway off the hook

Ferguson knocks over the bails, and the pressure pays off for the Punjab Kings! Slower ball on a back of a length on middle stump. Dube swings like a rusty gate and swings at it at least a week early. Done all ends up by the knuckle-ball, and the middle stump bail has been whipped off. Big, big wicket, and Dube, after a cameo, falls with the asking run-rate climbing!
hard length on middle and off. Conway chips it very tamely towards long off and that will be just another single
full toss just outside off and that deserved to be smashed into the stands. Instead, Dube cloths it and the ball bobbles down to long on
banged into the track outside off and this balloons over the batter's head. Left alone by Dube and called a wide
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Dube has a wild slog across the line and does so very, very early. Beaten completely by the lack of pace
slower ball well down leg. Conway misses it and the keeper fumbles too, allowing Dube to get across. Two bonus runs for CSK
full toss wide outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and scuffs it towards long off. That wide line is working for PBKS against Dube
top, top over! Full and wide, making Dube hit to one of his lesser accessed areas. He sits deep in his crease and powers it on the bounce to long off. Just six off the 15th!
banged into the track outside off. Conway slaps it towards extra cover and Stoinis sprawls to his right to get a big hand on it. Just a single
dropped again - PBKS are mirroring and rivaling CSK on this count tonight! Full ball wide outside off. Dube dabs it straight to Ferguson at backward point, who puts down a fairly regulation chance!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Conway stands up tall and hacks it powerfully to long on
nails the wide yorker, kissing the tramlines outside off. Dube reaches out for it and guides it towards deep backward point, stationed very fine
back of a length outside off. Conway throws his hands at it and scuffs it towards deep point
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Conway comes forward and pushes it towards long on to keep strike
safe! Dug into the track, angling into off stump. Dube gets a little cramped on the pull and shanks it towards deep mid wicket
kaboom! That has flown an absolute mile! Slot ball on the stumps, and Dube lays into this. Clean swing through the line and he hoists it onto the second deck over long on! A 93m six!
into the blockhole on the pads. Conway tucks it off his toes towards deep backward square leg
hold the pose, Devon Conway! Right in the slot on leg stump and Conway takes full toll. Uses his strong wrists and shovels it over wide long on. Brings up his fifty and he holds the key here for CSK!
Conway finds the gap, and he finds the fence! Tests out the middle of the track outside off but this time, Conway is waiting for it. Snaps into position and clubs it past deep mid wicket!
good bouncer that gets up near Conway's head. He rolls his wrists and helps it towards deep backward square leg. Tough to hit that for six
cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Conway has a swipe at it but swipes at it two business days early. Beaten all ends up by the deception
slower bumper on leg stump. Dube waits and waits and waits for it before pulling it towards deep backward square leg

on the bounce again! Slower ball on a full length on the pads. Conway heaves it towards deep backward square leg. Shashank goes for the catch and puts his body on the line. Loses track of the ball for a moment but recovers to keep it to one. Saved a boundary too!
full and bowled a mile outside leg. Conway gets nowhere near it but luckily for PBKS, Prabhsimran does
hard length on middle and leg. No room to work with this time and Conway stabs it straight back to the bowler
flat as a tank! Stoinis welcomed with a six! Dug into the track on leg stump. Conway sweats on this short ball and whacks it over deep square leg!
no chance for Shreyas this time! Goes short again but this is a cutter. Does not get up very high and Dube, waiting for it, pulverizes it to mid off's right!
sharp bumper on middle and leg. Dube spots it just in time and ducks under it rather frantically. Excellent change in length by Jansen
safe again! CSK riding their luck! Pushed in full on the pads. Conway gets under it and flicks it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
and a misfield now - this is spreading very quickly! Very full just outside off. Dube digs it out towards mid off, where Shreyas lets it go through his legs. Only a single conceded, though

dropped again - what is happening out there?! Slow and short outside off. Conway wants to play the upper-cut but has no pace to work with. Thakur gets into a tangle at deep third and ends up grassing it
did that carry?! Full and slanting into the pads. Conway flicks it uppishly and that seems to carry through to Chahal at short fine leg. He cannot hold on to it, and Conway gets a reprieve
another slower ball, on a back of a length on leg stump. Conway swishes and misses again and the ball dribbles off the thigh pad into the on side
off-pace and Thakur gets the radar wrong on this. Conway swings and misses, and the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length on middle and off. Dube gives himself a bit of room and jabs it towards sweeper cover
slower ball on a full length on middle and leg. Conway comes forward and knocks it to long on
Conway breaks the shackles too! Full toss outside off and Conway has enough room to work with. Opens his bat face slightly too and scorches it to extra cover's right!
just short! Bumper outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and slashes it on the bounce to Chahal at deep third
off-pace on a back of a length on middle and off. Conway hacks it towards deep mid wicket
hard length just outside off. Dube stays leg side of the ball and prods it towards extra cover. Throws his head back in disappointment soon after. Perhaps wanted a single to stay on strike
slower ball on a length well outside leg. Dube fails to lay bat on ball, and the umpire has some more exercise to indulge in
fetch that, says Shivam Dube! Another attempted short ball but this sits up on off stump. Dube gets his front hip out of the way and smears it flat over deep mid wicket. First six of the innings!
full on middle and off. Conway plants his front foot and powers it down the ground to long on
slower ball that goes awry and slides down leg. Conway swings and misses, and then sees the umpire stretch out his arms
sizzling yorker on leg stump. Conway is late to get his bat down on the flick and the ball smashes him on the boot
shortish again, on middle and off. Dube gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side for a single
safe again! Sharp bumper on leg stump and this gets awfully big on Dube. He is rushed on the pull and the ball lobs up off the top edge, just clearing short fine leg
miscued but safe! Hard length just outside off. Conway has a massive mow across the line and gets it wrong. Fortunately for him, it has enough to clear mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Keeps a little low and Dube chops it towards deep point
full outside off, with a bit of shape away. Dube's feet are stuck to concrete and he pokes it, flat-footed, towards mid off
deft touch! Slower short ball outside off. Dube picks it really early and rather than trying to drag it to leg, he opens his bat face to glide it between short third and backward point!
banged into the track just outside off. Dube rises with the bounce and muscles it over mid wicket for a couple of runs
slower ball on a length on middle and leg. Conway has a swipe across the line and the ball trickles off the back thigh towards short third
back of a length just outside off. Dube's feet go nowhere and he plays with an open bat face towards backward point
shot! Dug into the track outside off and this sits up a little. Dube spots it early, frees his arms and slaps it between extra cover and mid off!
hard length just outside off. Skids off the surface and gets big on Dube, who can only dab it straight to backward point
back of a length, sliding down leg. Dube does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
just over! Fullish, angling across the batter outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and skews it just over the fielder at mid off. Off the mark with a brace

goneski! Gaikwad bites the dust, and CSK's chase hits another enormous snag! Back of a length just outside off. Holds a little in the surface and Gaikwad, looking to punch on the up, mistimes it. Arrows off the inside hafl of the bat and Shashank snaffles it up smartly at short mid wicket. CSK lose two in quick succession, and PBKS tighten their grip on this contest!
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad presses half forward and taps it tamely towards backward point
slanted in on a back of a length on leg stump. Conway plays all around it and gets rapped on the pads. Superb over by Maxwell
back of a length just outside off. Conway hangs back and stabs it towards backward point
low full toss just outside off. Gaikwad gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg

Ravindra runs past one, and CSK's opening stand has come to an end, as soon as the powerplay got over! Fizzed in on a back of a length outside off. Bowled at 97.1kph but that still gripped and spun. Maxwell, perhaps, also anticipated the charge and Ravindra, swiping at it in an ungainly fashion, could only swat away a few flies. Sharp work by Prabhsimran, and CSK are one down!
lbw shout, not given! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Conway shapes for the reverse and makes a mess of it. Might have grazed the glove
shortens the length on off after seeing Ravindra advance. He punches it to long off
angled in on a length on the pads. Ravindra misses his flick and the ball trickles off the pad into the on side
banged into the track on off. Conway rolls his wrists over it and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Ravindra has a swish at it and carves it on the bounce to backward point. Just short of Chahal and Ravindra is lucky that did not carry
angled in full on leg stump. Ravindra gives himself room and opens his bat face to slice it to deep point's right. Has enough time to get back for two
dismisses this from his presence! Marginally short outside off and this sits up for Ravindra. He waits deep in his crease, with his front hip opened up, and demolishes it past mid wicket!

goes a mile up, but does not go as far! In the slot on middle and leg. Ravindra gets under it but no power on it at all. Not enough, at least. Plugs in front of deep mid wicket and Ravindra has to settle for a brace
back of a length outside off. Ravindra tries to force that through the off side and ends up scuffing it towards cover. Tried to hit that too hard. Jansen has overstepped, though...
fired in on a length on leg stump. Ravindra works it towards square leg, who puts in a dive to his left and gets a strong hand to it, ensuring it is just a single
slower and fuller on off. Conway gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards deep cover
short and wide outside off. Conway gets decent purchase on the cut but cannot get it past backward point
short and put away by Conway! Dragged down on the stumps. Conway picks the length early, rocks backk and pounds it to mid on's left!
tossed up full outside off. Ravindra plants his front foot and drills it down the ground to long off
back of a length on middle and leg. Punched down the ground to long on
three fours in a row! On a length outside off. Ravindra gets forward, stays on top of the bounce and cracks it past cover point. Another classy stroke!
that is a scorching shot! Off-pace again and sitting up to be hit outside off. Ravindra stands tall and threads it between extra cover and mid off!

streaky but guess what, they all count! Cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Ravindra skips down the track, has an agricultural swipe at it and squirts it off the inside edge through fine leg!
back of a length on the stumps. Conway helps it towards deep backward square leg
length just outside off. Conway gets a half stride in and jabs it towards extra cover
that has been absolutely smashed! Banged into the track outside off. Conway stands up on his toes, picks his spot and pummels it past mid wicket!
back of a length on off. Ravindra presses half forward and stabs it towards extra cover
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Ravindra waits for it and cuts it straight to backward point. He will feel he missed out there
fullish just outside off. Ravindra gets a good stride in and drives it towards extra cover
short, wide and punished! Skips through nicely onto Ravindra but he watches the ball all the way, meeting it late and slashing it over the keeper's head!
length just outside off. Conway gets onto the front foot and taps it towards backward point
shot! Full enough outside off and Conway does not miss out this time. Gets his hands through the ball and blasts it past extra cover!
back of a length just outside off. Conway drops it right beside him and calls his partner through for the single. Excellent over from Yash Thakur!
banged into the track on middle and leg and that is a response to Conway coming down the track. He has to take evasive action and hurriedly ducks under it
full and wide outside off. Conway gets onto the front foot and drives it towards cover
oh! Length ball in the channel and this seems to just straighten a shade after pitching. Conway, having advanced, goes feeling for it and is beaten on the outside
back of a length outside off. Ravindra has a waft at it and squirts it off the inside edge. Arshdeep makes up lots of ground on the fine leg fence and seems to pull it back in. Top hustle!
length outside off. Ravindra gets onto the front foot and jabs it towards cover. Good work by Stoinis to his left to stop it
fullish in the channel. Shapes away a little and Conway, pressing forward, drives with an open bat face towards point
Conway is up and running too! Back of a length, offering a hint of width. Conway lets the ball do its thing before playing right under his eyes. Bisects backward point and short third with precision!
back of a length outside off. Ravindra gets up on his toes and jabs it enough to extra cover's right to pick up a single
back of a length outside off. Ravindra waits for it and opens his bat face to dab it towards short third

Ravindra off the mark with a four! Back of a length outside off. Ravindra rises with the bounce, gets on top of it and cuts it past cover point. Deep backward point, running to his left, slides but the ball trickles into the rope off his hand!
back of a length outside off. Shapes away and also keeps a little low. Ravindra goes wafting at it and only connects with fresh air
